title: Ireland – Human resources management consultancy services – TR5801 - Leadership, Culture and Organisational Capability Services Framework
description: ESB intends to establish a multi-party Framework Agreement for the provision of Leadership, Culture and Organisational Capability Services to support the delivery of ESB's Culture and Capability Strategy. The Framework Agreement will provide access to expert service providers to support the co-design, development, deployment and ongoing evolution of Culture and Capability initiatives across ESB. The proposed scope includes the following service areas: Employee and Manager Capability Development; Leadership Development; Strategic Workforce Planning and Talent Management; Digital, Data and AI; and Organisation Development, Change Management, Culture and Future of Work.. Applicants are not required to demonstrate expertise across all service areas. Applicants may demonstrate relevant experience and capability within one or more areas of the overall Framework scope. The Framework Agreement will have an initial term of three years. The Contracting Entity reserves the right to extend the Framework Agreement for further period or periods, up to a maximum total Framework Agreement duration of eight years.

title: Expert Services for Participatory Design, Visualization, and Policy Support in the Horizon Europe Project UTOPIZE
description: Aalto University (hereafter also “Customer” or "contracting entity") is looking for expert services (hereafter “Service”) for the Horizon Europe project UTOPIZE. The Service supports the design and implementation of cross-sectoral workshops, participatory co-design methods, AI-based visualization, digital twin integration, and policy recommendation development. UTOPIZE is a transdisciplinary initiative under the New European Bauhaus that reimagines public spaces through inclusive design, sustainability, and cultural resonance. Aalto University, Department of Architecture, is responsible for developing and leading several tasks within the work packages (WP1–WP4), with activities requiring advanced facilitation, technical visualization, and policy translation. This Service supports tasks where external expertise is critical due to technical complexity, required international benchmarking, and participatory engagement. More detailed description of the Service can be found in Annex 1 (The Work) of the Invitation to tender. Aalto University explicitly encourages tenderers from world-class academic institutions with relevant track records, including academic centres recognized for their excellence in cross-sectoral workshop design, community engagement, climate actions and digital spatial tools.

title: Cric pneumatic profesional cu perna de aer 6 tone Barracuda B-SD1406
description:
Descriere Barracuda 6T cric perna de aer cu capacitate de ridicare de 6000 kg Cricul pneumatic Barracuda 6T este unul dintre instrumentele mai specializate folosite de profesionisti. Atelierele de mecanica auto, fermele sau instalatiile de vulcanizare sunt locuri in care ascensoarele sunt folosite in fiecare zi. Ascensorul pneumatic Barracuda are o constructie puternica si stabila care garanteaza cel mai inalt nivel de siguranta la ridicarea vehiculelor. Masina de ridicat tip om de zapada este echipata cu roti de cauciuc care pot fi manevrate liber pe aproape orice suprafata si o perna cu protectie suplimentara. Capacitatea maxima de ridicare de 6T garanteaza posibilitatea utilizarii mufei pentru cele mai grele vehicule. Flansa telescopica rigida si echipamentul cu supapa de siguranta faciliteaza orice lucrare care trebuie facuta. Více informací viz návrh smlouvy dle příslušné části zakázky (přílohy č. 1 a 2 této výzvy).
